blocks.html:
Programmer, entrepreneur, co-founder and CTO of Therapify, a mental health care platform. Experienced in developing mobile-first platforms, he specializes in the tools of the Google Cloud ecosystem and the Kotlin language. He took his first steps in the IT industry in a software house, developing mobile applications for the financial sector, retail and e-commerce, to finally find himself in the startup industry.

In the meantime, he was developing new projects after hours, he was a mentor to a group of young programmers. One of his projects turned into full-time work on his own business. In his work, he prefers a pragmatic, iterative approach to software development, always keeping in mind the business goals of the project. Privately, a fan of mountain expeditions and strategy games.
